hook.en: Searching your bag for a pen, you stop as soon as you find it. Checking answer papers, you skip the absent students. Python has break and continue for exactly these jobs.
hook.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಗ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೆನ್ ಹುಡುಕುವಾಗ ಸಿಕ್ಕ ತಕ್ಷಣ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸುತ್ತೀರಿ; ಉತ್ತರ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ತಿದ್ದುವಾಗ ಗೈರುಹಾಜರಾದವರನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟುಬಿಡುತ್ತೀರಿ. ಇದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಪೈಥಾನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ break ಮತ್ತು continue ಇವೆ.

objectives.en: Use break to end a loop early
Use continue to skip one iteration

narration.en: Searching your bag for a pen, you stop as soon as you find it. Checking answer papers, you skip the absent students. Python has break and continue for exactly these jobs.
narration.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಗ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೆನ್ ಹುಡುಕುವಾಗ ಸಿಕ್ಕ ತಕ್ಷಣ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸುತ್ತೀರಿ; ಉತ್ತರ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ತಿದ್ದುವಾಗ ಗೈರುಹಾಜರಾದವರನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟುಬಿಡುತ್ತೀರಿ. ಇದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಪೈಥಾನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ break ಮತ್ತು continue ಇವೆ.

body.en: The break statement alters the normal flow of a loop: it terminates the loop in which it appears, and execution resumes at the statement just after the loop. It is normally placed inside an if, so that the loop ends as soon as some condition is met, for example as soon as a divisor is found when testing whether a number is prime.

points.en: Control goes to the first statement after the loop

narration.en: The break statement alters the normal flow of a loop: it terminates the loop in which it appears, and execution resumes at the statement just after the loop. It is normally placed inside an if, so that the loop ends as soon as some condition is met, for example as soon as a divisor is found when testing whether a number is prime.
narration.kn: break ಹೇಳಿಕೆ ತಾನು ಇರುವ ಲೂಪ್ ಅನ್ನು ತಕ್ಷಣ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಲೂಪ್ ನಂತರದ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: break versus continue

say.en: Picture the loop for num in 1 to 6 as a row of boxes.
With break at num equal to 4, we print 1, 2, 3 and then jump right out. Five and six are never visited.
With continue at num equal to 4, only that one box is skipped. The loop carries on with 5 and 6.
So break prints 1 2 3, and continue prints 1 2 3 5 6.

narration.en: We compare break and continue on the same loop.

body.en: When continue is executed, the remaining statements of the loop body are skipped for the current iteration and control jumps back to the loop header to start the next iteration. The loop itself does not end. In a while loop, make sure the loop variable is updated before continue, or the loop may never end.

points.en: continue → skip the rest of this iteration
The loop goes on with the next value
In while loops, update before continue

narration.en: When continue is executed, the remaining statements of the loop body are skipped for the current iteration and control jumps back to the loop header to start the next iteration. The loop itself does not end. In a while loop, make sure the loop variable is updated before continue, or the loop may never end.
narration.kn: continue ಹೇಳಿಕೆ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಯ ಉಳಿದ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಮುಂದಿನ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಲೂಪ್ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳ್ಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

caption.en: for i in range(1, N + 1): if i % k == 0: continue, then print(i). The multiples of k are skipped; everything else is printed.

tryThis.en: With N = 10 and k = 3, list the printed numbers and check the count.
Set k = 1. Why is nothing printed?
Set k larger than N. What does continue do now?

narration.en: for i in range(1, N + 1): if i % k == 0: continue, then print(i). The multiples of k are skipped; everything else is printed. With N = 10 and k = 3, list the printed numbers and check the count.

body.en: break is the exit door: you leave the room (the loop) at once. continue is the skip button on a music player: this song stops, but the next one plays.

mnemonic.en: break = EXIT door; continue = SKIP to next

narration.en: Think of break as the exit door and continue as the skip button.

problem.en: Check whether 91 is a prime number. Stop testing as soon as a divisor is found.

narration.en: 91 is 7 times 13. When d reaches 7 the remainder is 0, so flag is set and break stops the search; there is no need to test 8 to 90.

problem.en: Print the numbers from 1 to 10 except the multiples of 3, on one line.

narration.en: For 3, 6 and 9 the continue statement skips the print, and the loop goes on with the next number.
Roll-call quiz. When your roll number is called, give your answer.
narration.kn: ಹಾಜರಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹಾಜರಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕರೆದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ತರ ಹೇಳಿ.

narration.en: Board exam pattern questions. Read every option before you choose.

points.en: break ends the loop at once.
continue skips only the rest of the current iteration.
points.kn: continue ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಯ ಉಳಿದ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Both are usually written inside an if inside the loop.
points.kn: ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಲೂಪ್ ಒಳಗಿನ if ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತೇವೆ.

homework.en: Write a program that keeps adding numbers from a list and stops (break) when a negative number is met.

narration.en: Recap. break ends the loop at once. continue skips only the rest of the current iteration. Both are usually written inside an if inside the loop.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವಲೋಕನ. break ಲೂಪ್ ಅನ್ನು ತಕ್ಷಣ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. continue ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಯ ಉಳಿದ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಿಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಲೂಪ್ ಒಳಗಿನ if ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತೇವೆ.
